defs.def: to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available 选择；挑选；选取

ex.s: Choose a parking zone.
ex.t: 选择停车区域。

ex.s: In your free time, you can explore the city, have language classes, surf or choose your favourite from among the following.
ex.t: 在空闲时间，你可以探索城市、上语言课、冲浪，或从以下选项中挑选你最喜欢的。

ex.s: There was just one thing I hadn’t counted on: My brother chose to bring his dog Toby, a 50-pound ball of fire.
ex.t: 只有一件事我没料到：我弟弟选择带上他的狗Toby——一个50磅重的小火球。

ex.s: Tips on Choosing HouseplantsD.
ex.t: 关于选房的提示 D.

ex.s: To reduce our impact, we can take simple steps: empty the fridge before heading out, and choose sustainable dining options.
ex.t: 为了减少我们的影响，我们可以采取简单的步骤：出门前清空冰箱，并选择可持续的就餐选择。

ex.s: TransForm allows you to get to focus on your chosen track through subject matter talks, hands-on workshops, and off-site experiences.
ex.t: TransForm允许您通过主题演讲，实践讲习班，以及场外体验，专注于您选择的轨道。

ex.s: When asked why they chose so many AP classes, my friends responded: “I don’t know.” They themselves don’t know why they are following the crowd and longing for the pressures of academic difficulty.
ex.t: 当被问及为什么选择这么多AP课程时，我的朋友们回答说：“我不知道。”他们自己也不知道为什么要随大流，为什么渴望学业压力。

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个顶级建议是：选择一个象征新“章节”开始的重要日期会很有帮助。

ex.s: “You choose which length you want and it gives you a receipt-like short story.”
ex.t: “你选择想要的长度，它就给你一个像收据一样的短篇故事。”

ex.s: Choosing a print publisher.
ex.t: 选择一家印刷出版商。

ex.s: They will sniff out specific areas before they choose a place to relax.
ex.t: 它们在选择一个地方放松之前，会先嗅探特定区域。

ex.s: Choosing what to read became easier.
ex.t: 选择读什么书变得更容易了。

ex.s: Before choosing to study online, consider whether you’re a self-motivated learner and if the material seems interesting enough to keep you going.
ex.t: 在选择在线学习之前，要考虑自己是否是一个有自学动力的人，以及学习材料是否足够有趣能让你坚持下去。

ex.s: Choose their partners.
ex.t: 选择他们的搭档。

ex.t: 是什么让约翰逊小姐选择教师作为职业？

ex.s: If you choose to drop a course you must follow the UCLA procedures for removing it from your schedule.
ex.t: 如果你选择退一门课，你必须遵循UCLA将其从你的课表中移除的程序。

ex.s: Some instructors choose to put previous test papers on library reserve,  making them available to all students.
ex.t: 一些教师选择把往年试卷放在图书馆 reserve，让所有学生都能借阅。

ex.t: 如果交换生选择停止修读一门课，他们该怎么做？

ex.s: Several violins hung from the dark walls, quietly waiting to be chosen.
ex.t: 几把小提琴挂在暗色的墙上，静静地等待着被选中。

ex.s: My childhood was all about the pursuits I had attempted most of which had been chosen by Mom.
ex.t: 我的童年全是关于我尝试过的那些追求，其中大多数都是妈妈替我选的。

ex.t: 选择住在旅店的旅行者的主要关切可能是什么？

ex.s: More than half of Australian homes are still choosing to stick with their home phone.
ex.t: 有年幼孩子的X一代人，像我和我妻子一样，仍然觉得有座机比为每个家庭成员提供手机更方便。

ex.s: Neither of them chose the moment that had transformed them.
ex.t: 它们都没有选择改变它们的时刻。

ex.t: “病人有权选择他想谈什么。”

ex.s: She chose the UW-Eau Claire program at Ministry Saint Joseph’s Hospital in Marshfield because she was able to pursue her four-year degree close to home.
ex.t: 她选择了位于马什菲尔德的明斯特圣约瑟夫医院的UW-Eau Claire项目，因为她能在离家近的地方攻读四年制学位。

ex.s: That day I chose to stop hiding and embrace my shyness.
ex.t: 成功不仅仅在于谁能喊得最响亮。这个世界也需要安静的人。

ex.s: Depending on which role you choose，you could help to increase a community's access to safe drinking water，or help to protect valuable local cultures.
ex.t: 根据你的角色选择，你可以帮助某个社区获得安全饮用水，或帮助保护宝贵的当地文化。

ex.s: She chose to consult dentists.
ex.t: 她和他争辩了。

ex.s: Which activity will you choose if you want to go camping?

ex.s: Directions: Fill in each blank with a proper word chosen from the box.
ex.t: 说明：从方框中选出合适的词填入每个空白处。

ex.t: 显然，不与特定银行或特定国家挂钩的货币这一概念对许多人很有吸引力。

ex.t: 剧院老板埃德·布拉德福德说他选择这部电影是因为它似乎很合适。

ex.s: At the end of the thirty days, you will then add back a small number of carefully chosen online activities that you believe will provide massive benefits to the things you value.
ex.t: 在这三十天结束时，你再重新加入少量精心挑选的线上活动，这些活动你认为会为你所看重的事物带来巨大益处。

ex.s: That freedom to choose is one reason more people like to eat alone.
ex.t: 选择自由是越来越多的人喜欢独自就餐的一个原因。

ex.s: The way you handle chopsticks is important to avoid annoying your companions.
ex.t: 你使用筷子的方式很重要，避免惹恼同伴。

ex.s: Alistair had to choose -brotherly love, or a chance to win the race?
ex.t: 阿利斯泰尔必须选择——兄弟之情，还是赢得比赛的机会？

ex.s: As Aristotle said, no one would choose to live without friends, even if he had all other goods.
ex.t: 正如亚里士多德所说，没有人会选择没有朋友的生活，即使他拥有所有其他商品。

ex.s: If you need a good night's sleep, choose a tea that helps you relax.
ex.t: 如果您需要睡个好觉，请选择一种有助于放松的茶。

defs.def: to prefer or decide to do sth 宁愿；情愿；决定

ex.s: I decided to play with him with only one toy for as long as it would keep his interest I expected that one toy would keep his attention for about five minutes, ten minutes, max I chose a red rubber ball—simple, universally available.
ex.t: 我决定只用一个玩具陪他玩，只要还能吸引他的兴趣就行；我估计一个玩具大概能让他专注五分钟，最多十分钟。我选了一个红色的橡皮球——简单、随处可见。

ex.s: Why were the 10 people chosen for the experiment?
ex.t: 为什么这10个人被选中参加这项实验？

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？
